name: tools-vgmtrans-v1
title: VGMTrans v1.2
description:
This tool converts music files used in console video games into standard MIDI and DLS/SF2 files. It also plays these files in-program.

Notes:
- Requires Microsoft Visual C++ 14.0 or later runtimes to be installed to run.
- This version is 64-bit only. Versions for macOS and other platforms can be found in the GitHub page.
